npcs.name: Sunny Smiles
dialogue: Careful out past the signpost — geckos have been getting bold again. If you're sticking around, I could use a hand with that.
Best shot in Goodsprings, and that's not just me saying it. Doc Mitchell can vouch — he's the one who patched up what the geckos left behind.

npcs.name: Ringo
dialogue: I'm just passing through, same as anybody. Though with those Powder Gangers sniffing around, "passing through" might take longer than I'd like.

npcs.name: Trudy
dialogue: Don't mind the dust, just mind your caps. And if you run into Sunny, tell her the generator's acting up again.
We get all sorts passing through. Ringo's one of the quieter ones — can't say the same for some of the others.

npcs.name: Doc Mitchell
dialogue: Glad to see you back on your feet. That was a nasty bit of business, getting shot in the head. Come by if the dizziness doesn't let up.
Don't push yourself. If you're hurt, I can patch you up — that's what I'm here for.
The geckos have been bold lately, and there's talk of Powder Gangers over at the prison. Keep your wits about you out there.
